item: Row 361 group 8: synthesis window, bulk panel and queue, custom extractor follow a language switch
summary: The last app-analysis.js units on the row 352 list. The synthesis window (title, buttons, selection step, result), the bulk translate/summary panel, its queue and the custom-extractor panel are drawn through ooLive/ooLiveHtml (row 364), so a language switch redraws them without a fetch. A redraw keeps what the reader did: ticks, the target language, the skip box and the extractor picked are read back from the screen first; a fresh open starts from the defaults. Parts whose text changes later (the count, the busy Run button, the extractor's progress line) are LEAVES inside a frame with no words of its own, because a drawn parent whose text changes under it reads as a foreign write and stops following the switch. The extractor's progress render is kept per panel, so a reopened panel shows a run still in flight. The mind map already follows a switch by re-fetching in the new language (anMindmapRepaint), which the scanner cannot see through its by-name call; its host is now marked off the walker so keyword labels are never read as chrome. '(untitled)' now goes through t(). No new strings; the ten list lines for app-analysis.js are gone.
